Description: ROUND AN - ONE OF THE BASIC THREE BEERS (Anthony, 8 Oct). Plain beer from your own Brewery: one random ability with a good side when he attacks and a bad side when he defends (Brews.csv rows with Pool plain). Small, so it fills the drunk meter only a little (INSPIRATION 10%). Wears off at the final whistle. The Bottling Machine fills 6 from a barrel (BottleSizes.csv).
